title: Concept: MD5 use via CC_MD5 (objc) — review required
description: In objc, CC_MD5 computes MD5. Collision attacks let an attacker forge a second input with the same digest, which defeats signatures and integrity checks while leaving non-security checksums unaffected. The objc-specific remedy is CC_SHA256.
applicability: objc codebases hashing data through CC_MD5; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Forged integrity values and signatures when MD5 protects untrusted data; LOW severity as a default because checksum uses dominate, raised on review when the digest is security-relevant.
